notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower-specific source is the Forest Lookouts page, which gives the name and county and nothing else (no height, builder, date, staffing or status). Two web searches and one Wikipedia read found no tower history. The Wikipedia article (read, not in the story's footnotes as a tower source) cites a Miami Herald article by Brian Blanchard, 11 Oct 1981, p. 143, headlined 'Tiny Miles City plays a towering role in Glades fire protection' (via Newspapers.com). That is the best lead for a real history and it is NOT opened; the story does not rely on it. Check it before adding any build, staffing or fate facts. The 2015 Florida Forest Lookout Association report excerpt that search returned does not mention Miles City. The firetower.org former-sites register was not checked for a Collier County entry. The record's coordinates are a few km from the community's Wikipedia coordinates, so they look right. Status remains unknown; the story says only what the sources support. No photos found.
